text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH priority - GPU attach denies in us-west1 causing autoscaler to stall. Queue growth observed on inference-router-04. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-attach-fail

oncall-javier: I'm on it. acked, joining bridge.

action-deploy-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1726007777

infra-ryan: Observed repeated attach failures from cloud API: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` for GPUs in us-west1. Autoscaler keeps requesting nodes but GCP returns attach error. Stack snippet:
```
2026-02-14T14:12:02Z attach_worker.go:52 error: attach failed: quotaExceeded: Request for nvidia-tesla-a100 in us-west1 failed: QUOTA_EXCEEDED (projects/infra-prod)
```

eng-sre: That aligns with the surge in queued requests — queue length up x6 over baseline and 95th latency for hosted generation routes up ~900ms. Low-priority batch jobs are filling warm pools.

ops-lin: Mitigation plan proposal:
1) Enable emergency fallback in autoscaler to allow smaller GPUs / mixed CPU fallback for non-latency critical jobs
2) Throttle/evict user-tier=dev jobs
3) Reroute new allocations to us-west2 and us-central1 until quota cleared
4) Open support case with GCP for quota bump

oncall-javier: Agreed. Applying (1) and (2) now.

infra-ryan: Applied emergency fallback: `POST /internal/autoscale/policy` payload:
```
{
  "region":"us-west1",
  "emergency_fallback":"enabled",
  "fallback_target":"mixed-small-gpu,cpu" 
}
```
Response: 200 OK. Warm pool rebalancer running.

eng-sre: Throttled tenant tag=dev. Batch size suggestion: reduce to 1 for streaming models to reduce GPU hold time.

cust-elaine: Customer impact: ~12 hostnames showing elevated error rates, primarily lower-tier PLG customers. No enterprise SLA hits at this time. Notifying support tier-1 to hold for comms.

infra-ryan: Opened GCP support case 987654321 - "Quota request in progress - project infra-prod - gpu quota exhausted us-west1". ETA from provider unknown.

oncall-javier: Also enabling region fallback routing: `reroute-policy set --from us-west1 --to us-west2,us-central1 --priority low` — done.

eng-sre: After changes queue length cut by ~60% in 7 minutes, attach error rate dropped. Monitoring to confirm drain. Graphs: https://grafana.redwood/d/queues/inference-router-04

ops-lin: Note for postmortem: add play to proactively pre-request regional quota and synthetic attach probes during peak deploys.

oncall-javier: Handing off to infra-ryan for follow-up and customer comms. I'll stay on-call for 30m. :thumbsup:

infra-ryan: Will follow up with support and escalate if GCP doesn't respond in 1h. Creating runbook task: `DR-1726007777`.

deploy-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial (fallback active, reroute active). Will update to resolved once warm pools stable and queue < baseline.

cust-elaine: Communicated interim status to affected customers via status page and support tickets. No customer escalations so far.

oncall-javier: Last check: attach errors down to baseline, queue trending to normal. Marking last_message_ts=1726008240 for thread. Closing active pager, leaving followup tasks.

infra-ryan: Follow-ups: verify quota increase or adjust long-term capacity, and add pre-emptive quota alert. I'll own.
